children: Canterbury Park's revenue rose 4.2% and net income increased year over year, driven primarily by higher casino revenue from increased table-games drop, visitation and spend per visit; pari-mutuel revenue declined.
¹ Reported as “Total Net Revenues”. ² Reported as “NET INCOME (LOSS)”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings (loss) per share”.
: Revenue rose 13.8%, primarily on increased table-games drop from higher visitation and spend per visit.
: Revenue fell 9.5%, primarily due to lower out-of-state handle from smaller average field sizes per race.
: Revenue increased 2.9%, helped by higher traffic and attendance per live race day and a new point-of-sale system.
: Declined 9.8%, primarily because there were fewer concert events year over year.
: Increased 27.8% to $3.8M; the increase was primarily due to higher income before taxes.
